text:
Although it's great to see initiatives to make Hebrew classes more affordable to non Olim (the effort is appreciated) and because as far as I know they don't offer any options to study remotely (unless it has changed recently), this offer remains restricted to those who live close enough to Tel Aviv to attend physically every day. 
Not everyone here lives in Tel Aviv, but we all need Hebrew in our everyday lives, so it would be great to see offers that cover remote learning as well...
